iWant: to set, change or stop my check-ins by asking Squire
soThat: I pick my check-in rhythm in plain words, without editing a settings file
description: A check-in the Squire owner asks for is written where Squire's check-ins are read, and changed or stopped the same way. Delivery stays the wake-up story's.
title: The Squire owner sets their check-ins by asking

acceptanceCriteria.description: The Squire owner sets, changes or stops a check-in by asking Squire, and Squire writes it where its check-ins are read.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A Squire owner talking with Squire
acceptanceCriteria.when: The Squire owner asks for a check-in at a time, asks to change it, or asks to stop it
acceptanceCriteria.then: The check-in is set, changed or removed as asked, in the Squire owner's settings where Squire's check-ins are read; a rhythm more often than hourly is set as asked, with one plain sentence that frequent check-ins use the plan faster.
